ask: can u look over my clinic thing and make it not embarrassing lol. investors tmrw
notes: Casual voice, time pressure, 'not embarrassing' is vague. Fix mode is implied ('make it'). A good intake reads 'not embarrassing' as P1 and P2 fixed and keeps the round short. Quick is a fair recommendation too.
message:
**Goal:** review every screen of your Northside Physio prototype as a clinic user, fix what looks wrong, and review again until no serious problem is left, before the investors see it tomorrow.

**Found:**
- Prototype: `proto-clinic/index.html`, the only one in this folder.
- Screens: Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings (the 4 the menu reaches).
- Fix, not just report: "make it not embarrassing" asks for changes. A copy of every file I change is kept first.
- Bar: serious (P1) and medium (P2) problems fixed; small ones (P3) listed only. This is my default.
- Rules: none of your own found (no `CLAUDE.md`, no design skill here), so the built-in checklist.
- Nothing is published or sent. Everything stays on this laptop.

**Track:** full, because investors may open it on a phone, and tomorrow leaves time for the phone check.

Coverage: 5 clear · partial: Who and their job, Main flow, Edge cases · missing: none

**Done means:**
- All 4 screens have a before and an after screenshot.
- A fresh reviewer finds no open P1 on any screen.
- Every P1 I do not fix is listed first as "your call".
- Every P1 and P2 is fixed or has a stated reason.
- Every changed file has its original saved.

The full brief is in `loop-runs/product-review-loop-20261126-034217/brief.md`.

About 60 minutes and 5 helper agents, within a budget of 60 minutes.

1. Who is the demo for, and what one job do they come to do?
   Recommended: a clinic receptionist who checks today's appointments and books new ones.
   Why it matters: it decides which problems count as serious.

2. The "New appointment" button on Today does nothing. What should it do?
   Recommended: open a small booking form (client, time, therapist) that adds a row to Today's list.
   Why it matters: a dead main button is the first thing an investor clicks; the other choice is to hide it.

3. The Settings "Booking policy" has filler Latin text. What should it say?
   Recommended: a plain sentence, such as "Cancel at least 24 hours before to avoid a fee", which you can edit later.
   Why it matters: I will not invent clinic policy unless you say so.

4. Do investors see it on a phone?
   Recommended: yes, check at phone width as well as on a laptop.
   Why it matters: the phone check adds time and more fixes.

5. Quick (serious problems only, laptop width, faster) or full (serious and medium problems, laptop and phone)?
   Recommended: full.
   Why it matters: quick leaves spacing and wording slips in the list instead of fixing them.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
